description: Create a recurring chore or routine (repeats per an RRULE; verified live).

category_ids.description: Family-member category ids to assign (omit only with up_for_grabs).

recurrence.description: iCalendar RRULE without the "RRULE:" prefix, e.g. "FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR" (daily: "FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1"). Use BYHOUR for routine time-of-day.

routine.description: Set true to create a routine (habit-style recurring task) instead of a chore.

up_for_grabs.description: Set true for an unassigned "anyone can do it" chore (requires no category_ids).

name: skylight_create_recurring_chore
